headline: ARI @ STL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ARI 5.02 at STL 5.03, with a projected total of 10.05. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ARI: ARI moved +0.92 runs while STL moved +0.74, changing the projected margin by +0.17 runs. The projected total climbed +1.66, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -17.7%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Michael McGreevy has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Alec Burleson, Ketel Marte, Gabriel Moreno, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jorge Barrosa because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
